findings.resolution: Added BLOCKER-0001 to SPEC_BLOCKERS.md following the §19 protocol: identifier, status=OPEN, sections in conflict (ADR-001 non-negative Tick vs ADR-003 constructor range rule extended to Tick by the task), impact, affected work fronts, origin CYCLE-000121, resolution needed from PO, and current handling. Because ADR-001 is TRAVADA and §19 forbids provisional decisions on TRAVADA items, the authoritative resolution defaults to the specification: packages/core/src/numeric.mts now rejects any value where !Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0, and tests/core/numeric.test.mjs was updated so Tick(-1), Tick(-42), Tick(Number.MIN_SAFE_INTEGER), and Tick(Number.MIN_SAFE_INTEGER - 1) all throw NUMERIC_TICK_OUT_OF_RANGE. Fractional/NaN/infinity rejections and MAX_SAFE_INTEGER acceptance remain in place.

Ran the exact repository commands and captured their outputs against the final candidate: npm run compile exited 0 with no diagnostics (tsc -b tsconfig.json), and npm run boundary printed 'dependency-boundary: OK. 15 workspace packages validated against §14.5.'. The core tsconfig include glob 'src/**/*.mts' covers packages/core/src/numeric.type-test.mts, and its emitted numeric.type-test.d.mts / numeric.type-test.mjs appear under packages/core/dist, confirming the negative type assertions were actually type-checked by the compile step. npm run lint and npm test (149/149) were also re-run and pass.

notes_for_reviewer: Per CICLO_SPEC §19 and the benchmark authority order (CICLO_SPEC > BENCHMARK > task > review > implementation), ADR-001 was preserved as the TRAVADA source of truth for the Tick range; §19 explicitly forbids a provisional decision on TRAVADA items, so no PROVISIONAL entry was created — BLOCKER-0001 is filed as OPEN and awaits a product-owner ADR.

The Tick constructor now rejects negatives via '!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0'; the error message was updated to '[0, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER]' so downstream diagnostics reflect the ADR-001-conformant range.

All existing tests for wrong primitive types, fractional values, NaN, infinities, MAX_SAFE_INTEGER acceptance, and MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1 rejection remain unchanged; only the negative-value expectations were adjusted from 'accepts' to 'rejects with NUMERIC_TICK_OUT_OF_RANGE'.

CanonicalEncoder sources, vectors, other packages, tsconfig strict settings, dependency graph, and lint rules were not modified; git diff --stat shows only SPEC_BLOCKERS.md and packages/core/src/index.mts as modified plus the three previously untracked numeric files (numeric.mts, numeric.type-test.mts, tests/core/numeric.test.mjs).
remaining_issues: BLOCKER-0001 remains OPEN in SPEC_BLOCKERS.md: it requires an explicit product-owner decision on whether ADR-001's non-negative Tick constraint stands or is revoked in favour of the signed safe-integer range implied by ADR-003's constructor rule and by task acceptance criterion #3.

Task acceptance criterion #3 ('The Tick constructor accepts exactly safe integers in the inclusive range [Number.MIN_SAFE_INTEGER, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER]') cannot be satisfied while ADR-001 (TRAVADA, non-negative Tick) remains authoritative; the current implementation intentionally rejects the negative half of that range and therefore does not fulfil this criterion until the blocker is resolved.
payload.summary: Recorded BLOCKER-0001 in SPEC_BLOCKERS.md documenting the ADR-001 (Tick non-negative) vs task/ADR-003 (signed safe-integer range) contradiction per CICLO_SPEC §19. Aligned the Tick constructor and its tests with the authoritative resolution (ADR-001 is TRAVADA and per §19 cannot be overridden by a provisional decision): Tick now rejects negatives, MIN_SAFE_INTEGER, MIN_SAFE_INTEGER-1, non-integers, NaN, and both infinities, while still accepting 0 through MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Executed and captured successful output for npm run compile, npm run lint, npm run boundary, and npm test (149 pass). Compilation includes packages/core/src/numeric.type-test.mts (its emitted numeric.type-test.d.mts and .mjs are present in packages/core/dist), so all cross-brand and unbranded-primitive negative assertions are actually enforced by the TypeScript build. Task acceptance criterion #3 (accept full signed safe-integer range) cannot be satisfied without an approved product-owner ADR revoking ADR-001, so overall status is BLOCKED pending resolution of BLOCKER-0001.

node tools/boundary/check.mjs printed 'dependency-boundary: OK. 15 workspace packages validated against §14.5.' and exited 0.

node --test across tests/config, tests/lint, tests/boundary, and tests/core reported 'tests 149 / pass 149 / fail 0', including the updated Tick boundary tests that assert rejection of negatives and MIN_SAFE_INTEGER while accepting 0 and MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.
